CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

July 23, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:02 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: July 9, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the July 9, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  1217 Saint Charles Terrace, DRB-2024-00055

  •  Request: This is an application for four (4) window replacements on an existing 2-
  story Craftsman residence.
  •  Applicant: Man San,
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

  1
 MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The windows shall provide a horizontal mullion that is proportional similar to
  the existing window grid pattern.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  201 West Main Street, DRB-2024-00045

  •  Request: This is an application for re-facing of the exterior fence and rails, new
  wood siding on the exterior walls, re-painting of stucco and block walls, re-painting
  of roof’s fascia, and repainting of the existing clock structure on an existing 1-story
  commercial restaurant.
  •  Applicant: Frank Nguyen and Ka Wai Kwan
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The project shall identify the proposed color, material, and finish of the window
  storefront frames.
  2. Revise the color and material board to accurately reflect the intended paint
  color, stain, and identify what is existing to be re-painted.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 4:  949 South Meridian Avenue, DRB-2024-00060

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 6 ft. high wrought iron gate, 6 ft. high
  motorized swing gate and sliding gate located at the front of the property behind
  existing landscaping.
  •  Applicant: Eric Ho
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

  2
 MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Revise the site plan to accurately callout the proposed fence location on the
  southwest corner.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit the two design options for the City Architect to
  select one and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 5:  1200 South Sierra Vista Avenue, DRB-2023-00208

  •  Request: This is an application to repair the existing retaining block wall along the
  property line with a stucco finish to match the existing, install a new 5 ft. high metal
  gate, a new 3 ft. high vinyl fence on top of the low retaining walls, new paving
  materials in the front and street side yard, and new artificial turf in the front yard.
  •  Applicant: Steve Chen
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to continue the application with conditions as
  follows:
  1. The applicant should work with City staff on re-designing the proposed fence
  and select a fence style that avoids substantially obscured views from the
  public realm while adding visual interest.
  •  The second was by Board member Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 6:  2 West Main Street, DRB-2024-00072

  •  Request: This is an application to repaint the exterior stucco and exterior
  storefront windows on an existing 1-story commercial building.
  •  Applicant: Donna Hong
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

  3
 MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The applicant shall present at least two design options that explores two
  different paint patterns and/or design for the exterior stucco, using the same
  colors identified in this plan set.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit the two design options for the City Architect to
  select one and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 7:  810 East Valley Boulevard, DRB-2023-00218

  •  Request: This is an application for one (1) new wall-mounted sign on an existing
  commercial tenant building frontage.
  •  Applicant: Nicky Chung
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions of approval:
  1. Reduce the total height of the proposed sign to a maximum of 32” to comply
  with The Plaza Alhambra Master Sign Program.
  2. Revise and resubmit the drawings for the City Architect to verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  Conditions of Approval:
  1. Reduce the total height of the proposed sign to a maximum of 32” to comply
  with The Plaza Alhambra Master Sign Program.
  2. Revise and resubmit the drawings for the City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  4
 ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:36 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on August 13, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:36 P.M.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
